CmdGlas Showcase

Everything built on 27 July 2026, in one file. Each panel tells you where it lives on screen and what to look at. The screenshots are the real thing, captured from the running build against a test database. None of it was drawn by hand.

01

PARTY VIEW

Tablet, top centre pill, Org/Party tab

Your crew now sits in a two column grid of tiles instead of a cramped run of pills. The leader comes first, then whoever is actually flying, then everyone else. Each tile carries the tac callsign, what that person is, and when you last heard from them.

  • A green dot and a green border mean their heartbeat landed inside the last three minutes
  • MEDIVAC and KIA sit on the tile itself rather than in a separate list
  • The four tiles above count who is on station, who is in the party, who is KIA and who needs a pickup
02

ORG VIEW

Tablet, top centre pill, Org/Party tab

Six squadrons fit on two lines now. The orders are abbreviated so nothing wraps mid word, and the full text is still there if you hover a tile, so nothing is actually lost.

  • YOUR TASKING is the only part of this panel that is about the person reading it
  • ATK, DEF, SUPP, GRD, LURE and DIST are the six order types
  • 2/2 means both assigned pilots are on station right now
  • MY COMMAND opens whichever console belongs to your rank
03

THREAT CHECK TAB

Tablet, top centre pill, Threat tab

The threat check has its own tab in the centre pill now, built from the same parts as the Org/Party tab so the pill keeps its shape.

  • Both ships get the best gun in the game on every pilot hardpoint they have
  • The only question it answers is who runs out of ship first
  • Both numbers are printed next to the verdict so you can check the arithmetic yourself
04

COMMS PILL, USER MANUAL ROW

Tablet, COMMS pill

A second row of buttons under OPEN, SET UP and UNDOCK, with enough clear space below it that it never touches the pill frame.

  • USER MANUAL opens the interactive guide in its own tab
  • UNDOCK floats it above your other windows using the Document Picture in Picture API
  • That API only exists in Chromium browsers. Anywhere else it opens a normal window and tells you why.
05

COMBAT STATE. UP, DOWN, RETURNING

COMMS, CHAT view, above your status flags

This is not an accordion, and that was deliberate. A pilot who just died has one hand on the stick and about two seconds of patience, so it stays visible with targets big enough to hit without aiming.

  • Three states, because being dead and being respawned but still flying back are different problems for a commander
  • One control rather than three buttons, because the states cannot both be true
  • Press the state you are already in and it clears
  • ALT+1, ALT+2 and ALT+3 work from anywhere on the page, and are ignored while you are typing
  • It is a browser key listener and nothing more. It installs nothing and never touches the game.
06

SUPPORT NET, RAISING A CALL

COMMS, CHAT view, every player sees this

Five calls any pilot can raise, with an optional line saying where they are. Underneath sits what you can provide, which is what makes the alerts find the right people.

  • Press a call a second time to stand it down
  • One live call per pilot per kind, so the panic button cannot be used as a drum
  • I CAN PROVIDE is your own declaration. Flag fuel and fuel calls will pulse at you.
  • ON THE WAY appears here the moment somebody answers, with their ETA attached
07

SUPPORT NET, THE BOARD

COMMS, PARTY CMD and ORG CMD

Every live call in one place. Answering one claims it for you and puts an ETA in front of the pilot who asked.

  • ETA choices are on station, within 1, 5, 15 or 30 minutes
  • A card only pulses for somebody who can actually answer it, so a fueler, a medic or a leader
  • If every card screamed, none of them would mean anything
  • EN ROUTE names who is coming and how long, so nobody sends two ships to the same pilot
08

PLANETSIDE DAY AND NIGHT

COMMS, ORG CMD, second tile on the top strip

The old manual DAY and NIGHT toggle is gone. Pick where you are fighting and it works the sun out for you: dayside or nightside, how long until the next sunrise and sunset, and how long that body's day runs.

  • Every time on this panel is in your local time, never UTC
  • 308 landing zones and stations across Stanton and Pyro
  • The maths is ordinary spherical astronomy and 43 assertions check it
  • CAUTION. The constants are datamined, not published by CIG. Two of them cross check exactly against starcitizen.tools. Day length is solid, but the sunrise clock can drift after a game patch.
09

MISSION PLANNER, BATTLE PLANS AND PHASES

COMMS, ORG CMD

Name a plan after the op and its phases are waiting for you the next time you run it. Each phase holds one order per squadron until you decide to fire it.

  • LAUNCH arms on the first press and fires on the second. It disarms itself after six seconds.
  • Launching writes every squadron's orders at once and shouts once on the org net
  • It also clears every pilot's o7, so they all have to acknowledge the new phase
  • The green strip at the top is what every pilot in the org sees
  • Fallback points A, B and C. RETREAT refuses to fire if the point has no location set.
10

THE RUNNING PHASE, AS A PILOT SEES IT

COMMS, CHAT view, above your orders

A running phase, or a retreat somebody just called, is news for the whole org. It shows even to a pilot whose own squadron has no order yet.

  • It is the first thing somebody who just logged in needs to know
  • A retreat turns this strip red and names the fallback point
11

SQUADRON BOARD, COLLAPSIBLE, WITH TIERED ALERTS

COMMS, ORG tab

Six squadrons will not fit side by side at any size you can read, so every column folds away. The alerting comes in two tiers on purpose.

  • Red at 2 Hz means act now: a KIA, an UNABLE, a support call, or an order ignored past its window
  • Amber at 0.5 Hz means know about it: a pilot has dropped off the net
  • A red state forces its column open. You do not get to miss a KIA because you had it folded away.
  • The blink clears when you look at it, not on a timer
  • The STEADY switch turns the flashing into a steady border, and the browser's reduced motion setting is honoured automatically
12

THE SAME BOARD, FOLDED

COMMS, ORG tab, FOLD ALL

A folded header still carries the counts and the reason, so a shut column is never a blind spot. A blink that does not say what happened just makes you open all six.

  • 1/4 KIA tells you what you need without expanding anything
  • OPEN ALL clears every blink at once, because you have now looked at them
13

ASSIGNMENT SHEET, MANNING TABLE

COMMS, ORG CMD, ASSIGNMENT SHEET

A turret gunner is always riding with a pilot, so the sheet reads like a manning table: each ship, then who is aboard it.

  • Whoever owns a ship takes the next whole number, so REAPER 1 then REAPER 2
  • Whoever rides someone else's ship takes that ship's number and the next suffix, so REAPER 1-1 then REAPER 1-2
  • RIDES WITH is where you say which ship a crew member is on
  • Crew with nothing set fall back to their element lead's ship, then to the first ship, and the sheet says so on screen
14

ORG DIRECTORY

COMMS, ORG tab, what a pilot with no org sees

Every org that has signed up, with the recruiting ones first, their quick read tags, and whatever charter their commander wrote.

  • RECRUITING or NOT RECRUITING is set by the commander and shown before anything else
  • Quick read tags cover 18+, SERIOUS, DAILY OPS, EU, NA, APAC, COMBAT, INDUSTRY and more
  • APPLY TO THIS ORG fills the form above and puts your cursor in the handle box
  • An org with its doors shut says so plainly instead of hiding
15

ORG PROFILE, WHAT RECRUITS SEE

COMMS, ORG CMD

The commander's shop window. Doors open or shut, the tags, and the charter.

  • The required field markers are back on the same line as their label. They were dropping onto a line of their own and reading as stray orange dots.
  • Eight tags show on the directory tile
  • The charter runs to 1200 characters
16

HAND OVER COMMAND

COMMS, ORG CMD, wing commander only

Pick any approved pilot and hand them the wing.

  • It arms on the first press and fires on the second, like everything else you cannot take back
  • They become Wing Commander. You drop to Squadron Leader, so you keep this console.
  • It promotes them first. If the second write fails you end up with two commanders, which you can fix, rather than none, which you cannot.
  • The founder record stays where it is. It grants no authority anywhere, and rewriting it would be a lie about who started the org.
17

STAND THE ORG DOWN

COMMS, ORG CMD, wing commander only

This files a request. It never deletes anything, because other people's history is in that org.

  • It flags the org for the system admin with your reason attached
  • It shows at the top of his console, above the queue of new orgs waiting for approval
  • Your members keep their channels until he acts
  • You can withdraw it at any time
